# MyCal AI

> MyCal AI is an Android calorie and nutrition tracker that logs a meal from one photo. It identifies every item on the plate separately (multi-item detection), estimates each portion, and gives calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber and sodium per item. It is tuned for Indian and regional dishes as well as global cuisine.

Key facts:

- Platform: Android (Google Play, package `com.mycalai.app`). No iOS version yet.
- Free plan: 2 AI photo scans a day, plus up to 3 bonus scans a day by watching a short ad.
- Premium: at least 15 AI photo scans a day, the AI Nutrition Coach (12 messages a day), and no ads. Weekly US$6.99, monthly US$16.99, yearly US$49.99 with a 3-day free trial. Google Play shows local prices in other countries.
- AI Nutrition Coach: answers questions using the user's own logged meals, not generic advice.
- AI Menu Scanner: photograph a restaurant menu and get dishes ranked for the user's goal and reported health conditions.
- Also: voice meal logging, water tracking, meal prep batches, progress photos, weight trends, Health Connect steps, group challenges, and a PDF health report export.
- MyCal AI gives nutrition estimates, not medical advice.
- Developer contact: support@mycalai.co
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mycalai/ (@mycalai)

- [Calorie tracker without barcode scanning](https://mycalai.co/calorie-tracker-without-barcode-scanning.html): photo-first logging for home-cooked meals
